questions.question: What is a linear equation?
questions.answer: A linear equation is an equation in which the highest power of the variable is 1.

questions.question: A linear equation has only one solution.

questions.answer: To find the value of the unknown variable.

questions.answer: Performing the same operation on both sides so that both sides remain equal.

questions.answer: Simplify the equation and isolate the variable.

questions.question: Explain how inverse operations are used to solve linear equations.
questions.answer: Inverse operations such as addition and subtraction or multiplication and division are used to isolate the variable and find its value.
